blurb: Burnside Brewing Company operates a brewery and several taprooms in Nova Scotia where guests can enjoy craft beer, rent kegs, fill growlers, and attend events like live music and trivia. Locations include Dartmouth, Truro, Antigonish, and New Glasgow, each with unique features such as rooftop patios and bowling alleys. They offer packaged beer for sale and support local food partnerships.
